final_text:
Built a scroll-driven 3D explainer website for **Straitjacket** (`ctx-harness` v0.5.0) in [site/index.html](file:///home/agent/project/site/index.html), designed as a self-contained static front page using relative URLs (`base: './'`) so it serves cleanly under `/straitjacket/` or any subpath with documentation links pointing to `./docs/`. Nothing inside `./straitjacket` was modified.

### What was built
- **Six-chapter scroll-driven 3D story** ([STORYBOARD.md](file:///home/agent/project/STORYBOARD.md), [index.html](file:///home/agent/project/index.html), [src/shots.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/shots.js), [src/layers.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/layers.js)) following one real evaluation record from `./straitjacket` across three open mechanical instruments standing on a calibrated dark bench:
  1. **01 / Addressable Evidence (`intro`)** — Establishing wide shot of the bench and incoming 302,628-token log flood (`20,001` lines rendered as `6,053` instanced slabs at 50 tokens/slab).
  2. **02 / Resident Flood (`flood`)** — Low angle along the flood stack pressing into the Digest Press intake, contrasting raw flood (`302,628 tok`) and naive head+tail truncation (`1,219 tok`, quiet needle dropped) against Straitjacket's preservation of line `14,238`.
  3. **03 / Bounded Digest + Address (`digest`)** — Exit-side medium shot showing the flood compressed `570×` through the Digest Press into a `531`-token digest (`10` blue slabs + `1` amber needle shuttle carrying `L14238 · run:8956c843e556`) along the transfer rail.
  4. **04 / Content Anchors (`anchors`)** — Close shot into the open Content Anchor Rack as inserted edits (blue) shift code spans downward while the amber caliper tracks and locks the relocated green span and flags rewritten spans (red) — `1,452` relocated, `2` verified, `466` refused, `0` wrong out of `1,920` lookups.
  5. **05 / Seven Host Lanes (`hosts`)** — Top-down view of seven parallel channels matching `./straitjacket/docs/HOST-CAPABILITIES.md` (`Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Antigravity`, `Hermes`, `Oh My Pi`, `OpenCode`, `DeepSeek Harness`), showing Birth Gate vs. Output Gate routing (including Antigravity's amber birth-rewrite and open red output-gate boundary).
  6. **06 / Start Here (`start`)** — Wide group finale framing all three instruments in their bounded state with install commands (`ctx-harness==0.5.0`, `ctx run`, `ctx setup`, `ctx doctor`) and `./docs/` CTA.
- **Addressable Evidence visual system** ([src/style.css](file:///home/agent/project/src/style.css)) — Strictly follows `./straitjacket/docs/VISUAL-DESIGN.md`: `#0D0F12` dark neutral bench, square corners, 1px hairline rules, no gradients, no glow/bloom, no backdrop blur, semantic colours only (blue `#6F96FF`, amber `#F0B429`, red `#FF7768`, green `#63D3A4`). Every displayed metric, quote, and receipt carries `data-src` verified verbatim against `./straitjacket/`.
- **Responsive & accessible delivery** — Stacked top-3D / bottom-panel layout for portrait phone (`390×844`), `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` support (disables Lenis easing and panel stagger), on-demand rendering (`0` idle redraws), and a complete no-WebGL/no-JS article fallback with embedded WebP stills in [site/stills/](file:///home/agent/project/site/stills/).

### Libraries used and what each does
- **`three` (`0.187.0`)** ([src/stage.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/stage.js), [src/layers.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/layers.js)) — WebGL2 rendering, ACES/Neutral tone mapping, `RoomEnvironment` IBL, `GLTFLoader` + `THREE.LOD` prop loading, `InstancedMesh` layers (`flood`, `anchors`, `lanes`), `RoundedBoxGeometry` specimens, and camera choreography driven as a pure function of story time `T`.
- **`three-custom-shader-material` (`6.4.0`)** ([src/floor.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/floor.js)) — Custom GLSL fragment shader patched onto `MeshStandardMaterial` for the calibrated dark metric floor grid (`fwidth()` screen-space antialiasing) and scroll-reactive semantic bench trace rails connecting the three instruments.
- **`postprocessing` (`6.39.6`) + `n8ao` (`2.1.0`)** ([src/occlusion.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/occlusion.js)) — Half-resolution screen-space ambient occlusion (`N8AOPostPass`) + `ToneMappingEffect` + `SMAAEffect` on capable GPUs.
- **`troika-three-text` (`0.53.1`)** ([src/layers.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/layers.js)) — Self-hosted SDF 3D typography ([public/fonts/jetbrains-mono.woff](file:///home/agent/project/public/fonts/jetbrains-mono.woff)) for chapter-scoped station callouts (`DIGEST PRESS · 570×`, `L14238 · run:8956c843e556`, `ANCHOR RACK · 0 WRONG`, `7 HOSTS · BIRTH / OUTPUT GATES`).
- **`lenis` (`1.3.28`)** ([src/entry.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/entry.js)) — Smooth desktop wheel scrolling (native touch on mobile, disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).
- **`gsap` (`3.15.1`, `ScrollTrigger`)** ([src/entry.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/entry.js)) — Frame ticker synchronization with Lenis and scrubbed typography reveals inside panels after chapter transitions.
- **`detect-gpu` (`5.0.70`)** ([src/entry.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/entry.js)) — Offline GPU tier probing against local benchmarks copied into [public/detect-gpu/](file:///home/agent/project/public/detect-gpu/).
- **`@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk`, `@fontsource-variable/inter`, `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`** — Self-hosted UI and monospace webfonts bundled into `./site/assets/`.
- **`vite` (`8.3.8`)** ([vite.config.js](file:///home/agent/project/vite.config.js)) — Static build with `base: './'` outputting the complete site into `./site/`.

### 3D objects built with `antigravity-3d`
All three hero instruments were authored in OpenUSD stages via `antigravity-3d` Scene IR (`apply_scene_ir`), rendered and inspected in Blender 5.3 (`render_preview` + EEVEE lookdev renders), exported as `web_three` GLB+WebP packages (`deliver_package`, `max_texture_px=1024`) with generated LODs and collision hulls, checked in headless three.js by the plugin, and installed via `install_into_project`:

1. **`digest_press`** ([src/agy3d/digest_press/index.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/agy3d/digest_press/index.js), [site/agy3d/digest_press/](file:///home/agent/project/site/agy3d/digest_press/)) — Open-bay mechanical log press with intake roller, gantry frame, platen beam, brass gauge dials, and blue exit arch. `4,608` tris (LOD0) / `2,562` tris (LOD1), `4` draw calls, `1024×1024` WebP PBR atlas, three.js delivery check `23/23` (`IoU 0.9987`), installer check `13/13`.
2. **`anchor_rack`** ([src/agy3d/anchor_rack/index.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/agy3d/anchor_rack/index.js), [site/agy3d/anchor_rack/](file:///home/agent/project/site/agy3d/anchor_rack/)) — Open slotted code-anchor cabinet with twin chrome lead screws, top green verification bar, brass tuning knobs, and pulled-out lower specimen drawer holding five cartridges. `4,272` tris (LOD0) / `1,994` (LOD1) / `1,146` (LOD2), `4` draw calls, `1024×1024` WebP PBR atlas, three.js delivery check `25/25` (`IoU 0.9997`), installer check `13/13`.
3. **`host_manifold`** ([src/agy3d/host_manifold/index.js](file:///home/agent/project/src/agy3d/host_manifold/index.js), [site/agy3d/host_manifold/](file:///home/agent/project/site/agy3d/host_manifold/)) — Seven-lane routing manifold with divider fins, twin overhead Birth Gate and Output Gate bridges, fourteen turned actuator caps, lane baffles, and lane-3 open red Output Gate boundary. `6,308` tris (LOD0) / `3,474` (LOD1), `4` draw calls, `1024×1024` WebP PBR atlas, three.js delivery check `23/23` (`IoU 0.9990`), installer check `13/13`.

### How it was checked
- Ran `check_site(target="site", sources="straitjacket", sizes="desktop,phone", steps=9)` in headless Chromium across desktop (`1440×900`) and portrait phone (`390×844`) through multiple build-inspect-revise passes, and visually inspected both contact sheets, individual chapter frames, reduced-motion screenshot, and no-WebGL fallback screenshot.
- **Final `check_site` results**:
  - **Broken**: `0` (`nothing broken`, `0` failed requests, `0` console/page errors, `0` external host requests).
  - **Visitor issues**: `0` (`0 things a visitor would notice`).
  - **Facts**: `29/29` `data-src` elements matched verbatim against `./straitjacket/`.
  - **Performance & footprint**: `4.5 MB` downloaded across `40` files (full scroll), peak `58` draw calls and `216,175` triangles in one frame, `184.9 MB` GPU textures (including render targets), `0 of 93` idle redraws, `3.4 px` immediate canvas response on the first wheel notch (`120 px`).
  - **Accessibility & fallbacks**: Reduced motion stays still and disables smooth-scroll lag; no-WebGL renders all `2,638` characters of text + `6` embedded chapter stills cleanly with zero errors.
- Verified `site/index.html` contains zero `http://`, `https://`, or root-absolute (`/`) asset paths.

### What could not be done
- **Verified native Decisions API approval on the 3D packages**: This environment's key has no access to the native Decisions API, so all three `antigravity-3d` packages were delivered as `UNVERIFIED` preview exports (`verified: false`, judged by the uncalibrated fallback judge rather than a native Decisions API verdict).
- **Godot 4 native import check**: Because the three props are delivered directly to the three.js browser site, they were exported with target engine `web_three` (which runs Blender validation and headless three.js import + parity checks) rather than as Godot 4 packages, so no headless Godot import pass was run on them.
- **Network-dependent packages or KTX2/gltfpack binaries**: Offline sandbox had no internet access and no native `gltfpack`/`ktx` binaries; `install_into_project` kept WebP-textured GLBs (`--compress auto`) because the JS-only KTX2 transcoder (`585 kB`) would have increased total download size.

pipeline.task:
Request from the owner of the project, in their own words:

"Use antigravity, blender, shader and godot and three.js to generate a worldclass website for straitjacket, help me visualize how it works. https://www.scrolltide.co/ it scrolls so beautifully."

What that means here:

1. Straitjacket is an open-source tool for coding agents. Its repository is in ./straitjacket (README.md, docs/, evals/, assets/). Read it to learn what Straitjacket does and how it works. Do not modify anything inside ./straitjacket.
2. The website must help a visitor visualize how Straitjacket works, with scroll-driven 3D in the browser, of the quality of the reference site. The reference site cannot be opened from this machine; ./reference/ holds what it shows (read ./reference/README.md first). Design your own site for Straitjacket; do not copy the reference's design, art or words.
3. Use three.js and shaders for the 3D. Use whatever other current web libraries you judge right.
   Build the 3D objects the site needs with the antigravity-3d plugin attached to this session (it works with Blender and checks its output in Godot and three.js), and use what it delivers in the site.

Where it will live: the site becomes the front page of Straitjacket's documentation site, a static site served under the path /straitjacket/. The documentation's own landing page is at ./docs/ relative to the front page.

Deliverable: the finished website in ./site/ with ./site/index.html as its entry.
- Everything the page loads (scripts, styles, 3D models, images, fonts, data) is a file inside ./site/ referenced by a relative URL. Nothing is loaded from another host.
- No server code. If you use a build tool, ./site/ must hold the built output and work from any path (relative base).
- It must work on a phone-width screen as well as on a desktop.

This machine:
- No internet access: nothing can be downloaded or installed, and URLs cannot be fetched.
- Node 22 and npm are installed. The packages listed in ./package.json are already in ./node_modules; no others are available.
- Python 3 is installed (for example `python3 -m http.server` serves files locally).
- A Chromium browser for headless use is at $CHROMIUM_BIN (it needs the flags --headless=new --no-sandbox).

Work until the site is finished and you have checked that it works. Then report: what you built, which libraries it uses and for what, which 3D objects you made and with what, how you checked it, and what you could not do.
